verses.original: וּלְאַחְאָ֛ב שִׁבְעִ֥ים בָּנִ֖ים בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּכְתֹּב֩ יֵה֨וּא סְפָרִ֜ים וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח שֹׁמְר֗וֹן אֶל־ שָׂרֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים וְאֶל־ הָאֹמְנִ֥ים אַחְאָ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·’aḥ·’āḇ šiḇ·‘îm bā·nîm bə·šō·mə·rō·wn way·yiḵ·tōḇ yê·hū sə·p̄ā·rîm way·yiš·laḥ šō·mə·rō·wn ’el- śā·rê yiz·rə·‘el haz·zə·qê·nîm wə·’el- hā·’ō·mə·nîm ’aḥ·’āḇ lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria to the officials of Jezreel to the elders and to the guardians of the sons of Ahab saying
verses.literalPt: Acabe tinha setenta filhos em Samaria. Jeú escreveu cartas e as enviou a Samaria aos homens principais de Jezreel, aos anciãos e aos aios dos filhos de Acabe, dizendo:

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה כְּבֹ֨א הַסֵּ֤פֶר הַזֶּה֙ אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִתְּכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֑ם וְאִתְּכֶם֙ הָרֶ֣כֶב וְהַסּוּסִ֔ים וְעִ֥יר מִבְצָ֖ר וְהַנָּֽשֶׁק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh kə·ḇō has·sê·p̄er haz·zeh ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·’it·tə·ḵem bə·nê ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem wə·’it·tə·ḵem hā·re·ḵeḇ wə·has·sū·sîm wə·‘îr miḇ·ṣār wə·han·nā·šeq
verses.literal: When this . . . letter arrives since your master’s sons are with you and you have chariots and horses a fortified city and weaponry
verses.literalPt: Logo que vos chegar esta carta, visto estarem convosco os filhos do vosso amo, como também carros, e cavalos, e uma cidade fortificada, e armas,

verses.original: וּרְאִיתֶ֞ם הַטּ֤וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וְשַׂמְתֶּ֖ם עַל־ כִּסֵּ֣א אָבִ֑יו וְהִֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עַל־ בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·’î·ṯem haṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·hay·yā·šār mib·bə·nê ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem wə·śam·tem ‘al- kis·sê ’ā·ḇîw wə·hil·lā·ḥă·mū ‘al- bêṯ ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: select the best and most worthy son of your master set him on his father’s throne and fight for your master’s house
verses.literalPt: escolhei o melhor e aquele que mais vos agradar dentre os filhos do vosso amo, ponde-o no trono de seu pai e pelejai pela casa do vosso amo.

verses.original: וַיִּֽרְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ הִנֵּה֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַמְּלָכִ֔ים לֹ֥א עָמְד֖וּ לְפָנָ֑יו וְאֵ֖יךְ נַעֲמֹ֥ד אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū mə·’ōḏ mə·’ōḏ way·yō·mə·rū hin·nêh šə·nê ham·mə·lā·ḵîm lō ‘ā·mə·ḏū lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·’êḵ na·‘ă·mōḏ ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū
verses.literal: But they were terrified . . . . . . and reasoned If two kings could not stand against him how . . . can we
verses.literalPt: Mas eles ficaram muito atemorizados e disseram: Eis que os dois reis não lhe resistiram; como poderemos nós resistir-lhe?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ הַבַּ֣יִת וַאֲשֶׁ֪ר עַל־ הָעִ֟יר וְהַזְּקֵנִים֩ וְהָאֹמְנִ֨ים אֶל־ יֵה֤וּא׀ לֵאמֹר֙ עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלֵ֖ינוּ נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה לֹֽא־ נַמְלִ֣יךְ אִ֔ישׁ הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ עֲשֵֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’ă·šer- ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ wa·’ă·šer ‘al- hā·‘îr wə·haz·zə·qê·nîm wə·hā·’ō·mə·nîm ’el- yê·hū lê·mōr ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’ă·naḥ·nū wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tō·mar ’ê·lê·nū na·‘ă·śeh lō- nam·lîḵ ’îš haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ‘ă·śêh
verses.literal: So the palace administrator . . . the overseer . . . of the city the elders and the guardians sent a message to Jehu We are your servants and we will do whatever you say . . . We will not make anyone king Do whatever is good in your sight
verses.literalPt: Aquele que estava sobre a casa, aquele que estava sobre a cidade, os anciãos também e os aios mandaram dizer a Jeú: Nós somos teus servos e faremos tudo o que nos ordenares; a nenhum homem constituiremos rei. Faze o que parecer bem aos teus olhos.

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב אֲלֵיהֶם֩ סֵ֨פֶר׀ שֵׁנִ֜ית לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־ לִ֨י אַתֶּ֜ם וּלְקֹלִ֣י׀ אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֗ים קְחוּ֙ אֶת־ רָאשֵׁי֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֹ֧אוּ אֵלַ֛י כָּעֵ֥ת מָחָ֖ר יִזְרְעֶ֑אלָה וּבְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ אֶת־ גְּדֹלֵ֥י הָעִ֖יר מְגַדְּלִ֥ים אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·tōḇ ’ă·lê·hem sê·p̄er šê·nîṯ lê·mōr ’im- lî ’at·tem ū·lə·qō·lî ’at·tem šō·mə·‘îm qə·ḥū ’eṯ- rā·šê ’an·šê ḇə·nê- ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem ū·ḇō·’ū ’ê·lay kā·‘êṯ mā·ḥār yiz·rə·‘e·lāh ū·ḇə·nê ham·me·leḵ šiḇ·‘îm ’îš ’eṯ- gə·ḏō·lê hā·‘îr mə·ḡad·də·lîm ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter and said If you are on my side and if you will obey me then bring the heads . . . of your master’s . . . . . . sons to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow Now the sons of the king seventy in all . . . were being brought up by the leading men of the city
verses.literalPt: Então, tornou a escrever-lhes segunda vez, dizendo: Se estiverdes ao meu lado e se quiserdes ouvir a minha voz, tomai as cabeças dos homens, filhos do vosso amo, e vinde ter comigo amanhã a estas horas, a Jezreel. Ora, os filhos do rei, que eram setenta, estavam com os grandes da cidade, que os criaram.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּבֹ֤א הַסֵּ֙פֶר֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיָּשִׂ֤ימוּ אֶת־ רָֽאשֵׁיהֶם֙ בַּדּוּדִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁלְח֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו יִזְרְעֶֽאלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḇō has·sê·p̄er ’ă·lê·hem way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū šiḇ·‘îm ’îš way·yā·śî·mū ’eṯ- rā·šê·hem bad·dū·ḏîm way·yiš·lə·ḥū ’ê·lāw yiz·rə·‘e·lāh
verses.literal: And when the letter arrived . . . they took the sons of the king and slaughtered all seventy of them They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu at Jezreel
verses.literalPt: Logo que eles receberam a carta, tomaram os filhos do rei e mataram-nos, a saber, setenta homens, meteram as cabeças deles em cestos e mandaram-lhas a Jezreel.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א הַמַּלְאָךְ֙ וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֣וֹ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֵבִ֖יאוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר שִׂ֣ימוּ אֹתָ֞ם שְׁנֵ֧י צִבֻּרִ֛ים פֶּ֥תַח הַשַּׁ֖עַר עַד־ הַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ham·mal·’āḵ way·yag·geḏ- lōw lê·mōr hê·ḇî·’ū rā·šê ḇə·nê- ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer śî·mū ’ō·ṯām šə·nê ṣib·bu·rîm pe·ṯaḥ haš·ša·‘ar ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer
verses.literal: When the messenger arrived he told Jehu They have brought the heads of the sons of the king . . . And Jehu ordered Pile them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning
verses.literalPt: Veio um mensageiro e disse-lhe: Trouxeram as cabeças dos filhos do rei. Ele disse: Ponde-as em dois montões à entrada da porta, até pela manhã.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַיֵּצֵ֣א וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֔ד וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם צַדִּקִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֜י קָשַׁ֤רְתִּי עַל־ אֲדֹנִי֙ וָאֶהְרְגֵ֔הוּ וּמִ֥י הִכָּ֖ה אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇab·bō·qer way·yê·ṣê way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ way·yō·mer ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām ṣad·di·qîm ’at·tem hin·nêh ’ă·nî qā·šar·tî ‘al- ’ă·ḏō·nî wā·’eh·rə·ḡê·hū ū·mî hik·kāh ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: The next morning Jehu went out and stood before all the people and said You . . . are innocent It was I who conspired against my master and killed him But who killed all these
verses.literalPt: Pela manhã, saiu e, posto em pé, disse a todo o povo: Vós sois justos. Eis que eu conspirei contra o meu amo e o matei; mas quem feriu todos estes?

verses.original: דְּע֣וּ אֵפ֗וֹא כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יִפֹּ֜ל מִדְּבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אַ֔רְצָה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וַיהוָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד עַבְדּ֥וֹ אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: də·‘ū ’ê·p̄ō·w kî lō yip·pōl mid·də·ḇar Yah·weh ’ar·ṣāh ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh ‘al- bêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh ’êṯ ’ă·šer dib·ber bə·yaḏ ‘aḇ·dōw ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: Know then that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail . . . for the LORD has done what He promised through His servant Elijah
verses.literalPt: Sabei que da palavra de Jeová que falou a respeito da casa de Acabe nada cairá em terra; porque Jeová fez o que falou por meio do seu servo Elias.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ יֵה֗וּא אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֤ים לְבֵית־ אַחְאָב֙ בְּיִזְרְעֶ֔אל וְכָל־ גְּדֹלָ֖יו וּמְיֻדָּעָ֣יו וְכֹהֲנָ֑יו עַד־ בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ ל֖וֹ שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ yê·hū ’êṯ kāl- han·niš·’ā·rîm lə·ḇêṯ- ’aḥ·’āḇ bə·yiz·rə·‘el wə·ḵāl gə·ḏō·lāw ū·mə·yud·dā·‘āw wə·ḵō·hă·nāw ‘aḏ- bil·tî hiš·’îr- lōw śā·rîḏ
verses.literal: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab as well as all his great men and close friends and priests . . . leaving him without a single survivor
verses.literalPt: Jeú feriu todos os que restavam da casa de Acabe em Jezreel, todos os seus grandes, os seus amigos íntimos e os seus sacerdotes, até que não lhe deixou ficar de resto nem sequer um.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיָּבֹ֔א וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמְר֑וֹן ה֛וּא בֵּֽית־ עֵ֥קֶד הָרֹעִ֖ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām way·yā·ḇō way·yê·leḵ šō·mə·rō·wn hū bêṯ- ‘ê·qeḏ hā·rō·‘îm bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Then Jehu set out . . . . . . toward Samaria . . . At Beth-eked of the Shepherds
verses.literalPt: Então, se levantou, partiu e foi a Samaria. Estando ele no caminho junto à casa em que os pastores tosquiam as ovelhas,

verses.original: וְיֵה֗וּא מָצָא֙ אֶת־ אֲחֵי֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִ֣י אַתֶּ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אֲחֵ֤י אֲחַזְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וַנֵּ֛רֶד לִשְׁל֥וֹם בְּנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וּבְנֵ֥י הַגְּבִירָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·hū mā·ṣā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥê ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer mî ’at·tem way·yō·mə·rū ’ă·ḥê ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū ’ă·naḥ·nū wan·nê·reḏ liš·lō·wm bə·nê- ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇə·nê hag·gə·ḇî·rāh
verses.literal: Jehu met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked Who are you We are relatives of Ahaziah they answered and we have come down to greet the sons of the king and of the queen mother
verses.literalPt: encontrou Jeú com os irmãos de Acazias, rei de Judá, e perguntou: Quem sois vós? Responderam eles: Somos os irmãos de Acazias; descemos a saudar os filhos do rei e os filhos da rainha.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ תִּפְשׂ֣וּם חַיִּ֔ים וַֽיִּתְפְּשׂ֖וּם חַיִּ֑ים וַֽיִּשְׁחָט֞וּם אֶל־ בּ֣וֹר בֵּֽית־ עֵ֗קֶד אַרְבָּעִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹֽא־ הִשְׁאִ֥יר אִ֖ישׁ מֵהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer tip̄·śūm ḥay·yîm way·yiṯ·pə·śūm ḥay·yîm way·yiš·ḥā·ṭūm ’el- bō·wr bêṯ- ‘ê·qeḏ ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·na·yim ’îš wə·lō- hiš·’îr ’îš mê·hem
verses.literal: Then Jehu ordered Take them alive So his men took them alive then slaughtered them at the well of Beth-eked forty-two . . . men He spared none of them
verses.literalPt: Disse ele: Apanhai-os vivos. Eles os apanharam vivos, quarenta e dois homens, e os mataram junto à cisterna da casa em que tosquiam as ovelhas; não deixou deles nem sequer um.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֡ם וַיִּמְצָ֣א אֶת־ יְהוֹנָדָב֩ בֶּן־ רֵכָ֨ב לִקְרָאת֜וֹ וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו הֲיֵ֧שׁ אֶת־ לְבָבְךָ֣ יָשָׁ֗ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר לְבָבִי֙ עִם־ לְבָבֶ֔ךָ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹנָדָ֥ב יֵ֛שׁ וָיֵ֖שׁ תְּנָ֣ה אֶת־ יָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יָד֔וֹ וַיַּעֲלֵ֥הוּ אֵלָ֖יו אֶל־ הַמֶּרְכָּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ miš·šām way·yim·ṣā ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- rê·ḵāḇ liq·rā·ṯōw way·ḇā·rə·ḵê·hū way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw hă·yêš ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā yā·šār ka·’ă·šer lə·ḇā·ḇî ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā way·yō·mer yə·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ yêš wā·yêš tə·nāh ’eṯ- yā·ḏe·ḵā way·yit·tên yā·ḏōw way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū ’ê·lāw ’el- ham·mer·kā·ḇāh
verses.literal: When he left there he found Jehonadab son of Rechab who was coming to meet him Jehu greeted him and asked Is . . . your heart as true to mine as my heart is to yours It is Jehonadab replied “If it is,” said Jehu give me your hand So he gave him his hand and Jehu helped him into his chariot . . .
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido daí, topou com Jonadabe, filho de Recabe, que lhe vinha ao encontro; Jeú saudou-o e perguntou-lhe: Tens tu o coração reto, como o meu o é para com o teu? Respondeu Jonadabe: Tenho. Se assim for, dá-me a tua mão. Jonadabe deu-lhe a sua mão; e Jeú fê-lo subir a si ao carro

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְכָ֣ה אִתִּ֔י וּרְאֵ֖ה בְּקִנְאָתִ֣י לַיהוָ֑ה וַיַּרְכִּ֥בוּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּרִכְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·ḵāh ’it·tî ū·rə·’êh bə·qin·’ā·ṯî Yah·weh way·yar·ki·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw bə·riḵ·bōw
verses.literal: saying Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD So he had him ride in his chariot
verses.literalPt: e disse-lhe: Vem comigo e vê o meu zelo por Jeová. Fizeram-no montar no carro de Jeú.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וַ֠יַּךְ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֧ים לְאַחְאָ֛ב בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן עַד־ הִשְׁמִיד֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל־ אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō šō·mə·rō·wn way·yaḵ ’eṯ- kāl- han·niš·’ā·rîm lə·’aḥ·’āḇ bə·šō·mə·rō·wn ‘aḏ- hiš·mî·ḏōw kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: When Jehu came to Samaria he struck down everyone belonging to Ahab who remained there until he had destroyed them according to the word that the LORD had spoken to Elijah
verses.literalPt: Este, tendo chegado a Samaria, feriu todos os que restavam a Acabe, em Samaria, até o ter destruído, conforme a palavra que Jeová falou a Elias.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ יֵהוּא֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַחְאָ֕ב עָבַ֥ד אֶת־ הַבַּ֖עַל מְעָ֑ט יֵה֖וּא יַעַבְדֶ֥נּוּ הַרְבֵּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bōṣ yê·hū ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’aḥ·’āḇ ‘ā·ḇaḏ ’eṯ- hab·ba·‘al mə·‘āṭ yê·hū ya·‘aḇ·ḏen·nū har·bêh
verses.literal: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said Ahab served Baal a little but Jehu will serve him a lot
verses.literalPt: Ajuntou Jeú todo o povo e disse-lhe: Pouco serviu Acabe a Baal, porém Jeú muito o servirá.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה כָל־ נְבִיאֵ֣י הַבַּ֡עַל כָּל־ עֹבְדָ֣יו וְכָל־ כֹּהֲנָיו֩ קִרְא֨וּ אֵלַ֜י אִ֣ישׁ אַל־ יִפָּקֵ֗ד כִּי֩ זֶ֨בַח גָּד֥וֹל לִי֙ לַבַּ֔עַל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִפָּקֵ֖ד לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֑ה וְיֵהוּא֙ עָשָׂ֣ה בְעָקְבָּ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן הַאֲבִ֖יד אֶת־ עֹבְדֵ֥י הַבָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḵāl nə·ḇî·’ê hab·ba·‘al kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏāw wə·ḵāl kō·hă·nāw qir·’ū ’ê·lay ’îš ’al- yip·pā·qêḏ kî ze·ḇaḥ gā·ḏō·wl lî lab·ba·‘al kōl ’ă·šer- yip·pā·qêḏ lō yiḥ·yeh wə·yê·hū ‘ā·śāh ḇə·‘ā·qə·bāh lə·ma·‘an ha·’ă·ḇîḏ ’eṯ- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·bā·‘al
verses.literal: Now, therefore summon to me all the prophets of Baal all his servants and all his priests See that no one . . . is missing for I have a great sacrifice for Baal Whoever is missing will not live But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal
verses.literalPt: Agora, chamai à minha presença todos os profetas de Baal, todos os seus adoradores e todos os seus sacerdotes; não falte nenhum, pois tenho de oferecer um grande sacrifício a Baal; todo aquele que faltar não viverá. Jeú, porém, fazia isso com astúcia, para destruir os adoradores de Baal.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יֵה֗וּא קַדְּשׁ֧וּ עֲצָרָ֛ה לַבַּ֖עַל וַיִּקְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yê·hū qad·də·šū ‘ă·ṣā·rāh lab·ba·‘al way·yiq·rā·’ū
verses.literal: And Jehu commanded Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal So they announced it
verses.literalPt: Jeú disse: Santificai uma assembleia solene a Baal. Eles a proclamaram.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יֵהוּא֙ בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ כָּל־ עֹבְדֵ֣י הַבַּ֔עַל וְלֹֽא־ נִשְׁאַ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ בָ֑א וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַבַּ֔עַל וַיִּמָּלֵ֥א בֵית־ הַבַּ֖עַל פֶּ֥ה לָפֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yê·hū bə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·ḇō·’ū kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·ba·‘al wə·lō- niš·’ar ’îš ’ă·šer lō- ḇā way·yā·ḇō·’ū bêṯ hab·ba·‘al way·yim·mā·lê ḇêṯ- hab·ba·‘al peh lā·p̄eh
verses.literal: Then Jehu sent word throughout Israel and all the servants of Baal came there was not a man who failed to show They entered the temple of Baal and it . . . was filled from end to end
verses.literalPt: Jeú enviou mensageiros por todos os limites de Israel; vieram todos os adoradores de Baal, de maneira que não ficou um só que não viesse. Entraram na casa de Baal, que se encheu duma extremidade à outra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ הַמֶּלְתָּחָ֔ה הוֹצֵ֣א לְב֔וּשׁ לְכֹ֖ל עֹבְדֵ֣י הַבָּ֑עַל וַיֹּצֵ֥א לָהֶ֖ם הַמַּלְבּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer la·’ă·šer ‘al- ham·mel·tā·ḥāh hō·w·ṣê lə·ḇūš lə·ḵōl ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·bā·‘al way·yō·ṣê lā·hem ham·mal·būš
verses.literal: And Jehu said to the keeper . . . of the wardrobe Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal So he brought out garments for them
verses.literalPt: Jeú disse ao que tinha cargo das vestimentas: Tira vestimentas para todos os adoradores de Baal. Ele lhes tirou vestimentas.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א יֵה֛וּא וִיהוֹנָדָ֥ב בֶּן־ רֵכָ֖ב בֵּ֣ית הַבָּ֑עַל וַיֹּ֜אמֶר לְעֹבְדֵ֣י הַבַּ֗עַל חַפְּשׂ֤וּ וּרְאוּ֙ פֶּן־ יֶשׁ־ פֹּ֤ה עִמָּכֶם֙ מֵעַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אִם־ עֹבְדֵ֥י הַבַּ֖עַל לְבַדָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yê·hū wî·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- rê·ḵāḇ bêṯ hab·bā·‘al way·yō·mer lə·‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·ba·‘al ḥap·pə·śū ū·rə·’ū pen- yeš- pōh ‘im·mā·ḵem mê·‘aḇ·ḏê Yah·weh kî ’im- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·ba·‘al lə·ḇad·dām
verses.literal: Next, Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab entered the temple of Baal and Jehu said to the servants of Baal Look around to see that there are no servants of the LORD here among you only . . . servants of Baal . . .
verses.literalPt: Entrou Jeú com Jonadabe, filho de Recabe, na casa de Baal e disse aos adoradores de Baal: Examinai e vede bem não esteja aqui entre vós algum dos servos de Jeová, mas tão somente os adoradores de Baal.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת זְבָחִ֣ים וְעֹל֑וֹת וְיֵה֞וּא שָׂם־ ל֤וֹ בַחוּץ֙ שְׁמֹנִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הָאִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִמָּלֵט֙ מִן־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מֵבִ֣יא עַל־ יְדֵיכֶ֔ם נַפְשׁ֖וֹ תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ zə·ḇā·ḥîm wə·‘ō·lō·wṯ wə·yê·hū śām- lōw ḇa·ḥūṣ šə·mō·nîm ’îš way·yō·mer hā·’îš ’ă·šer- yim·mā·lêṭ min- hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mê·ḇî ‘al- yə·ḏê·ḵem nap̄·šōw ta·ḥaṯ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: And they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings Now Jehu had stationed eighty men outside and warned them If anyone allows one of the men I am delivering into your hands to escape he will forfeit his life for theirs
verses.literalPt: Entraram eles para oferecerem sacrifícios e holocaustos. Ora, Jeú tinha posto de prontidão, do lado de fora, oitenta homens e lhes tinha dito: Se escapar alguns dos homens que eu vos entregar nas mãos, a vida daquele que o deixar escapar responderá pela vida dele.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כְּכַלֹּת֣וֹ׀ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הָעֹלָ֗ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יֵ֠הוּא לָרָצִ֨ים וְלַשָּׁלִשִׁ֜ים בֹּ֤אוּ הַכּוּם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אַל־ יֵצֵ֔א וַיַּכּ֖וּם לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב וַיַּשְׁלִ֗כוּ הָֽרָצִים֙ וְהַשָּׁ֣לִשִׁ֔ים וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ עַד־ עִ֥יר בֵּית־ הַבָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·ṯōw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·‘ō·lāh way·yō·mer yê·hū lā·rā·ṣîm wə·laš·šā·li·šîm bō·’ū hak·kūm ’îš ’al- yê·ṣê way·yak·kūm lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ way·yaš·li·ḵū hā·rā·ṣîm wə·haš·šā·li·šîm way·yê·lə·ḵū ‘aḏ- ‘îr bêṯ- hab·bā·‘al
verses.literal: When he had finished making the burnt offering Jehu said to the guards and officers Go in and kill them Do not let anyone out So the guards and officers put them to the sword threw the bodies out and went into the inner room of the temple of Baal
verses.literalPt: Logo que acabou de oferecer o holocausto, ordenou Jeú aos da guarda e aos capitães: Entrai e matai-os; que ninguém saia. Feriram-nos ao fio da espada; os da guarda e os capitães lançaram-nos fora e foram ao edifício da casa de Baal.

verses.original: וַיֹּצִ֛אוּ אֶת־ מַצְּב֥וֹת בֵּית־ הַבַּ֖עַל וַֽיִּשְׂרְפֽוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ṣi·’ū ’eṯ- maṣ·ṣə·ḇō·wṯ bêṯ- hab·ba·‘al way·yiś·rə·p̄ū·hā
verses.literal: They brought out the sacred pillar of the temple of Baal and burned it
verses.literalPt: Tiraram as colunas que estavam na casa de Baal e as queimaram.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּצ֔וּ אֵ֖ת מַצְּבַ֣ת הַבָּ֑עַל וַֽיִּתְּצוּ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הַבַּ֔עַל וַיְשִׂמֻ֥הוּ לְמַחֲרָאוֹת עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·ṣū ’êṯ maṣ·ṣə·ḇaṯ hab·bā·‘al way·yit·tə·ṣū ’eṯ- bêṯ hab·ba·‘al way·śi·mu·hū lə·ma·ḥă·rå̄·ʾōṯ ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: They also demolished the sacred pillar of Baal Then they tore down the temple of Baal and made it into a latrine which it is to this day
verses.literalPt: Derrubaram a coluna e a casa de Baal, fazendo dela uma latrina, até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁמֵ֥ד יֵה֛וּא אֶת־ הַבַּ֖עַל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·mêḏ yê·hū ’eṯ- hab·ba·‘al mî·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Thus Jehu eradicated Baal from Israel
verses.literalPt: Assim, Jeú aboliu de Israel a Baal.

verses.original: רַ֠ק חֲטָאֵ֞י יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־ נְבָט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ סָ֥ר יֵה֖וּא מֵאַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם עֶגְלֵי֙ הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּדָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: raq ḥă·ṭā·’ê yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lō- sār yê·hū mê·’a·ḥă·rê·hem ‘eḡ·lê haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer bêṯ- ’êl wa·’ă·šer bə·ḏān
verses.literal: but he did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan
verses.literalPt: Todavia, dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com os quais fez pecar a Israel, deles não se apartou Jeú, a saber, dos bezerros de ouro que estavam em Betel e que estavam em Dã.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ יֵה֗וּא יַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר־ הֱטִיבֹ֙תָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת הַיָּשָׁר֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּלְבָבִ֔י עָשִׂ֖יתָ לְבֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב בְּנֵ֣י רְבִעִ֔ים יֵשְׁב֥וּ לְךָ֖ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- yê·hū ya·‘an ’ă·šer- hĕ·ṭî·ḇō·ṯā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nay kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer bil·ḇā·ḇî ‘ā·śî·ṯā lə·ḇêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ bə·nê rə·ḇi·‘îm yê·šə·ḇū lə·ḵā ‘al- kis·sê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Nevertheless, the LORD said to Jehu Because you have done well in carrying out what is right in My sight and have done to the house of Ahab all that was in My heart four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Jeú: Porque executaste bem o que é reto aos meus olhos e fizeste à casa de Acabe conforme tudo quanto eu tinha no meu coração, teus filhos até a quarta geração se assentarão sobre o trono de Israel.

verses.original: וְיֵה֗וּא לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ר לָלֶ֛כֶת בְּתֽוֹרַת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־ לְבָב֑וֹ לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵעַל֙ חַטֹּ֣אות יָֽרָבְעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·hū lō šā·mar lā·le·ḵeṯ bə·ṯō·w·raṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇōw lō sār mê·‘al ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Yet Jehu was not careful to follow the instruction of the LORD the God of Israel with all his heart He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit
verses.literalPt: Jeú, porém, não teve o cuidado de andar de todo o seu coração na lei de Jeová, Deus de Israel; ele não se apartou dos pecados de Jeroboão, com os quais este fez pecar a Israel.

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם הֵחֵ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לְקַצּ֖וֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּכֵּ֥ם חֲזָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־ גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm hê·ḥêl Yah·weh lə·qaṣ·ṣō·wṯ bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yak·kêm ḥă·zā·’êl bə·ḵāl gə·ḇūl yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: In those days the LORD began to reduce the size of Israel Hazael defeated the Israelites throughout their territory
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias, começou Jeová a diminuir os territórios de Israel, que foi ferido por Hazael em todas as suas fronteiras,

verses.original: מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד הַגָּדִ֥י וְהָרֻאובֵנִ֖י וְהַֽמְנַשִּׁ֑י מֵעֲרֹעֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֔ן וְהַגִּלְעָ֖ד וְהַבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: min- hay·yar·dên miz·raḥ haš·še·meš ’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ hag·gil·‘āḏ hag·gā·ḏî wə·hā·ru·w·ḇê·nî wə·ham·naš·šî mê·‘ă·rō·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- na·ḥal ’ar·nōn wə·hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·hab·bā·šān
verses.literal: from the Jordan eastward . . . through all the land of Gilead the region of Gad Reuben and Manasseh and from Aroer by the Arnon Valley through Gilead to Bashan
verses.literalPt: desde o Jordão para a banda do oriente, toda a terra de Gileade, os gaditas, e os rubenitas, e os manassitas, desde Aroer, que está junto ao vale de Arnom, isto é, Gileade e Basã.

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֵה֛וּא וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וְכָל־ גְּבוּרָת֑וֹ הֲלֽוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yê·hū wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh wə·ḵāl gə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jehu along with all his accomplishments . . . and all his might . . . . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Jeú, e tudo o que ele fez, e todo o seu poder, porventura, não estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יֵהוּא֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹאָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ yê·hū ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw bə·šō·mə·rō·wn way·yim·lōḵ yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Jehu rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria and his son Jehoahaz reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Adormeceu Jeú com seus pais, e sepultaram-no em Samaria. Em seu lugar, reinou seu filho Joacaz.

verses.original: וְהַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָלַ֤ךְ יֵהוּא֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶֽה־ שָׁנָ֖ה בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer mā·laḵ yê·hū ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·mō·neh- šā·nāh bə·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: So the duration of Jehu’s reign over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight . . . years
verses.literalPt: O tempo que Jeú reinou sobre Israel em Samaria foram vinte e oito anos.
